front.title: Model Context Protocol and Agent Skills over Media over QUIC Transport

abstract.t:
This document defines how to use Media over QUIC Transport (MOQT) as the underlying transport protocol for the Model Context Protocol (MCP). MCP enables integration between language model applications and external data sources and tools. MOQT provides publish-subscribe delivery over QUIC and WebTransport with native prioritization, relay caching, and multiplexing.
This specification maps MCP messages onto MOQT objects and tracks. It covers MCP's tools, resources, prompts, multi round-trip requests, and the Tasks extension, and it uses MOQT relays to cache content that MCP marks as public across clients and to let a response outlive the connection that carried its request.
The document also describes Agent Skills, composed instructions that extend AI capabilities beyond atomic tool operations, using progressive loading aligned with MOQT's object-based delivery. The same tracks can run standalone or inside a dialog of the Protocol for Agent Communication Exchange (PACE).
